title: shindo theme: configurable colors (Olivero pattern)
description: Implement 5 color settings (primary, secondary, accent, background, text) as color_hex in config/schema/shindo.schema.yml. Add HTML5 color picker + hex textfield in theme-settings.php with #config_target. In preprocess_html: hex->HSL, inject as CSS custom properties on <html>. SCSS uses hsl(var(--color-primary-h) var(--color-primary-s) var(--color-primary-l)). Reference: /Users/boris/Sites/doesdesign/web/core/themes/olivero/theme-settings.php + olivero.theme.

title: shindo theme: configurable layout options
description: Add container_width (narrow/default/wide), sidebar_position (left/right/none), show_hero (bool) settings. Config schema + theme-settings form. preprocess_html adds body classes (shindo--container-narrow, shindo--sidebar-left etc). SCSS switches grid template based on classes.

title: Install and configure fontyourface for font selection
description: composer require drupal/fontyourface:^4.2, enable core module + google_fonts_api submodule. Admin imports Google Fonts via /admin/appearance/font-your-face and maps to CSS selectors (body, h1-h6). Document usage in shindo README. shindo does NOT duplicate a font picker in its own theme-settings; link to fontyourface UI in help text.
